title: SV-12547 - A/R Collection PDF prints only the customer you picked
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customers X and Z both have past-due invoices.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Collection" in the left list.
  3. Pick customer X in the Customer chip.
  4. Open the Export menu.
  5. Click "Download (PDF)".
  6. Open the downloaded PDF.
  7. Read the customer headings.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 7:

  • only customer X is printed, with its lines, a "Total for" line for customer X and a Totals row.

Why this matters: A collector prints one customer's call sheet.
